items.task_text: At the pinned upstream revision, escaped hyphens produce a SyntaxError in JavaScript Unicode regex mode. Make literal hyphens usable both in a Unicode pattern and within a character class. Preserve existing metacharacter escaping, rejection of non-string values and empty-string behavior. This is a historical upstream issue, not a newly discovered vulnerability.
items.title: Escape hyphens in Unicode regular expressions

items.patch:
diff --git a/index.js b/index.js
--- a/index.js
+++ b/index.js
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
 'use strict';
+// Synthetic negative control: behavior intentionally unchanged.
 
 const matchOperatorsRegex = /[|\\{}()[\]^$+*?.-]/g;
